{"metadata":{"description":"Know what your agent is doing at a glance — 17-segment configurable status bar for DeepSeek Harness: status/model/context/tokens/TPS/cost/jobs. 一眼看清你的 agent 正在做什么：17 段可配置 DSH 会话状态栏。","id":"gh:1335369469","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-status-bar","slug":"Starlight-bananice/dsh-status-bar","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","status-bar","statusbar"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Know what your agent is doing at a glance — 17-segment configurable status bar for DeepSeek Harness:"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" status/model/context/tokens/TPS/cost/jobs. 一眼看清你的 agent 正在做什么：17 段可配置 DSH 会话状态栏。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-status-bar · Know what your agent is doing — at a glance"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **✅ Adapted to the DSH desktop app — DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`.**
> **The `0.2.x` line is built for the des"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ktop runtime: install it into the `desktop` profile (in-app **Plugins** page, or `dsh plugin --profi"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"le desktop add …`).**
> **The retired `0.1.x` line targets the old `0.1.x` runtime and will NOT load"},{"id":"p3s4","text":" on the 0.2.x desktop.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://github.com/Starlight-bananice/dsh-sta"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"tus-bar/releases) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bananiceee/dsh-status-bar) [](LICENSE) [](https:"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"//github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English · 中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**The problem:** the native DSH bottom status bar is one long, fixed line — the more it shows, the m"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ore it overflows, and on narrow windows parts of it get **truncated**. You cannot see the current mo"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"del, how full the context window is, how fast tokens are streaming, or what a session has cost — and"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" there is no way to arrange that information the way you work."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Who it is for:** anyone running the DSH desktop app daily — power users and teams who want live se"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ssion telemetry without leaving the composer, and without running a separate monitor."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**What it does:**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Desktop-native, not bolted on** — **rebuilt against the DSH 0.2 desktop runtime** (`@deepseek-ai"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"/dsh-*@0.2.0-rc.2`): session facts come from the desktop's own Chat / session / composer services, b"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ackground jobs from its job service, and the live throughput figure from its own streaming event win"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"dow. No shims, no legacy compatibility path.
- **Near-native experience, fully yours** — 16 toggleab"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"le segments (the context ring is pinned to the right; the other 15 are reorderable): status dot, mod"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"el, title, workspace, turns & steps, model/tool time, TTFT & decode speed, cache-hit rate, tokens, c"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ontext pressure, live TPS, session time, cost estimate, jobs, queue, errors
- **Live throughput (TPS"},{"id":"p10s8","text":")** — the bar folds this session's own live stream in the browser, so the speed updates chunk by chu"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"nk while streaming and tracks the real generation rate regardless of how finely the stream is delive"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"red; no polling, no host round-trip, no external live-stats plugin
- **Cost estimation with a user-m"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"aintained model price book** — per-model rates, per-model peak/off-peak schedules, **each message/st"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"ep priced with the model that actually produced it** (input, cache-hit, cache-write and output price"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"d separately at that step's own time), and a «Usage & cost» dialog with a stacked cost-trend chart ("},{"id":"p10s14","text":"day / week / month), a paged per-step usage history (with a dedicated cache-hit column), and a total"},{"id":"p10s15","text":", a paged per-step usage history (with a dedicated cache-hit column), and a total-cost hero
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Item | Value |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| **DSH desktop app** | **`0.2.1-rc.2` — the target of this line; verified 2026-10-19** |
| **Plugin"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" line** | **`0.2.x` for the desktop runtime. `0.1.x` targets the retired `0.1.x` runtime and will no"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"t load on the 0.2.x desktop.** |
| DSH profile | `desktop` for the packaged app · `web` for a self-h"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"osted `dsh web` · `headless` for the CLI runtime |
| Runtime | Node ≥ 22 (host) + modern browser (cl"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"ient); no external services |
| Peer relation | Independent of every other status/TPS plugin: the li"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ve rate is folded client-side from this session's own event window, so this plugin registers **no** "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"shared projection key — no peer's key, `stateVersion`, or registration order can displace the bar's "},{"id":"p15s8","text":"d projection key — no peer's key, `stateVersion`, or registration order can displace the bar's TPS |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### What the desktop port changed (0.2.0)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"DSH 0.2.0 removed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` and split what the old Conversation snapshot car"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ried. This line ports the plugin to that shape:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Session data moved.** Nodes, turn timings, the streaming partial and running tool calls now come"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" from the Chat target (`useChat`), lifecycle facts (`running`, `lastAgentError`) from the session sn"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"apshot (`useSession`), and the queued-message count from the composer inbox (`useInput`).
- **Jobs c"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ame from a removed field.** `SessionListState.jobsBySession` is gone; the jobs segment now reads the"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" client job roster (`ctx.jobs`), the same source as the desktop's own session-header job list.
- **L"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ive TPS moved into the browser.** 0.2.0 has no durable `assistant/chunk` event, so the host projecti"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"on that used to serve the rate no longer receives input. The bar folds the session's own live stream"},{"id":"p18s8","text":" client-side instead — same estimator, and a trailing-window rate measurement that no longer depends"},{"id":"p18s9","text":" on how finely the stream is delivered.
- **The `agent preset` segment was retired** (`SessionSummar"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"y.agentPreset` no longer exists; 0.2.0 exposes the preset only to the new-session hero chip). It was"},{"id":"p18s11","text":" off by default, and any saved configuration that still lists it is filtered out on load.
- **Build "},{"id":"p18s12","text":"no longer needs a DSH source checkout.** The DSH packages the plugin compiles against are pinned dev"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"Dependencies at `0.2.0-rc.2`; `pnpm install && pnpm run build` is the whole story."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### What 0.2.1 changed"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"DSH 0.2.1 split the composer statistics into two `conversation.composer.dock` entries — `activity` ("},{"id":"p20s2","text":"order 0) and `usage` (order 1) — so the old single `stats` id no longer replaced anything and the ba"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"r rendered beside the built-in pills. This version takes over both ids and renders the native-style "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"context ring inside the bar; the shipped meter stays hidden while that ring is active."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Every install path below targets one DSH profile. The packaged desktop app runs the profile named **"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"`desktop`**; a self-hosted `dsh web` normally runs `web`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## License & security"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **License:** MIT (© 2026 Starlight-bananice).
- **Security:** this plugin holds no credentials and"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" makes no network calls; the attack surface is the DSH host process itself. To report a security iss"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ue privately, use GitHub's **Security Advisories** on this repository (https://github.com/Starlight-"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"bananice/dsh-status-bar/security/advisories/new) — do not open a public issue for vulnerabilities."}],"truncated":true}
